key_insight: XCAPE combines PXRD constraints with symmetry-aware evolutionary search and a universal machine-learning interatomic potential to recover physically plausible crystal structures.
engineering_relevance: The framework can help translate experimental diffraction measurements into atomistic models for materials discovery and automated research workflows.
method: Constrain the search using composition, unit cell parameters, space group, and PXRD data.
Explore Wyckoff-site configurations through symmetry-aware evolutionary search and tailored mutations.
Use a universal ML interatomic potential to accelerate geometry optimization and evaluate candidates by energy and diffraction agreement.
evidence_signal: XCAPE recovered 71/77 simulated-pattern benchmarks (92.2%) and all 12 experimental reference structures; among 12 additional candidate assignments without matching ICSD entries, DFT placed 10 within 10 meV/atom of the convex hull.
watch_item: Agreement with PXRD and low calculated energy do not establish a unique structure; new candidate assignments still require independent validation.
paper_title: Physics-Guided Crystal Structure Elucidation from Powder X-Ray Diffraction with Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
